firing_model.ammo_capacity: total initial rounds including loaded magazine
firing_model.burst_interval: previous burst last shot to next burst first shot
firing_model.cadence_quantization: authored intervals are positive whole 0.1-second frames
firing_model.legacy_reload_s: compatibility sustained mean interval; use magazine_reload_s for actual reload duration
firing_model.reload_rule: empty magazine auto reload; next shot waits for max(cadence due, reload completion); no free ammo
firing_model.reserve_ammo: ammo minus magazine_ammo, including during reload

accuracy.baseline: stationary shooter; point-target probability (direct) or real geometric aim spread (area); no command buff; terrain/protection affect damage separately
accuracy.close_interpolation: linear from close_multiplier at zero to 1 at close_range_m
accuracy.direct_motion_model: one probability roll; successful direct fire resolves on current living target; no second geometry hit roll
accuracy.indirect_formula: uniform seeded disk: maximum radius meters = blast_radius_m * 0.85 / max(quality,0.05); radial=sqrt(uniform); no separate probability hit roll
accuracy.indirect_motion_model: unguided area rounds lead current target velocity; AA missile tracks with fixed seeded error; targets may evade area rounds
